manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify the official-index disclosure page exposes only a latest-public old-year target PDF, not a strict FY2026 success.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the information page and inspect the 修学支援 / 申請書 link.
Follow shugakushien_shinsei2025-1-2.pdf despite the 2025 filename hint.
Reject it from strict FY2026 success because the remaining 2026 body text is a program completion-year label, not filing or target-FY evidence.
Keep it as publication-lag evidence for operator review.

reusable_rules: Use the official-index disclosure page before SERP fallback.
Treat PDF-body target-year evidence as stronger than stale-looking URL or anchor hints only when the year context is a filing/target-FY label.
Keep 2025 in the URL/anchor as publication-lag evidence when the body lacks current filing-year evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not infer the fiscal year solely from the URL filename.
Do not accept stale-looking PDFs unless body extraction or OCR supplies the configured target fiscal year in a filing/target context.
Do not count adjacent school-information or admission PDFs as confirmation forms.

evidence.notes: Windows v231 full Saitama replay rejects this PDF as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 after the detector stopped treating 完成年度は2026年度 as target-FY evidence.
